desc: Formalize the constraint model: person = interval [p,q] on W-positions with type U/D; feasibility = no strict cycle; derived and verified against samples that this equals absence of conflicting pairs (shared left/left or right/right endpoints any type; same-type proper interleaving).
Replace conflict-pair enumeration with sliding-window existence checks (1D segment trees with transient ≤2 occupants per leaf via packed slots), avoiding 2D max-index queries.
Verify sliding-window validity and query rule (Yes iff L ≥ left[R]) on both samples by hand.
Implement the full Python solution (fast I/O, iterative segment trees, packed leaf occupancy, two-pointer window, left[] array, O(1) queries).

Test the implementation against the two provided samples and brute-force small random cases (exhaustive W assignment for tiny N) to confirm the pairwise-conflict characterization and the window logic.
